summary: Implemented a bounded external transport trace candidate below the worker interface. A reusable summarizer derives external reads/writes/waits/retries only from typed transport observations and emits numeric values only with COMPLETE_FOR_SCOPE coverage. A closed fixture proves exact nonzero and evidenced-zero behavior; malformed coverage/local/retry cases fail. A minimal real sample from this claim confirms three durable GitHub writes but correctly keeps total writes plus reads/waits/retries UNKNOWN because the connector does not close the transport stream.
tests: PASS closed trace => reads=2, writes=3, waits=2, retries=1.
PASS closed-zero => waits=0 and retries=0 only with non-empty coverage evidence.
PASS real partial trace => writes UNKNOWN with observed_minimum=3; reads/waits/retries UNKNOWN.
PASS incomplete coverage without unknown_reason is rejected.
PASS COMPLETE_FOR_SCOPE without coverage evidence is rejected.
PASS local operation class is rejected and local_work_events_persisted=0.
PASS RETRY requires explicit underlying external operation class.
unresolved: A connector/runtime transport hook is still required before real complete per-operation read/write/wait/retry counters can be claimed.
truth_boundary: Candidate observability only. No WORKER_PIPELINE, scheduler, queue or Current mutation; no claim that the present connector exposes a complete real transport trace.
